digest.component_or_area: plan-review audit and detail rendering surfaces
propositions: Plan-material-pin health metrics (drift, enforcement posture, phase compatibility) must be exposed in detailed review surfaces (CLI show, MCP detail, audit output, close errors, web UI) without persisting warning events or affecting ordinary list output.

All detailed renderers must consume the DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract without independently defining status strings, displaying canonical related tickets, normalized roles, pinned/current fingerprint status, and missing-target state.

Audit rendering must call compute_validity at the build_context/page assembly boundary after audit_trail produces stored data, catching missing attestation or exceptions and rendering derived-health as unavailable without changing audit_trail behavior or close validity semantics.

Pin enforcement disabled state must be labeled as advisory drift, legacy-unpinned must be distinguishable from current-no-relationships, and stored ticket events and ordinary list output remain unchanged.

Output schemas, rendering tests, and advanced documentation must cover plan-material-pin, phase metadata, rollout behavior, deletion repair, and validity profiles; basic user docs must not include this material.
